title: Sharp Lifespan Estimates for a Semilinear Wave Equation with Nonlinear Damping
summary: We study the maximal existence time $T^{*}(\varrho)$ of the solution of the semilinear wave equation $u_{tt}-Δu=u|u|^{p-1}-u_{t}|u_{t}|^{q-1}$ in a bounded domain, with Dirichlet boundary condition and initial data $(\varrho f,\varrho g)$, where $1 2p/(p+1)$, whereas the energy method gives a lower bound of order $\varrho^{1-p}$ only. We prove lower bounds with the same exponents as the upper ones, so that $T^{*}(\varrho)\asymp\varrho^{-\vartheta(p,q)}$ with $\vartheta(p,q)=\min\{(p-1)/2,\,(p-q)/q\}$.
